label: At D2 after a2 to S2, strongest when the last a2-S2 reward followed a non-reward; grows over the episode.
terms: (phase == D2) * (action == 2) * (state == 2) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 2) * (state == 2) * ep_trial ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 2) * (state == 2) * last_is("a2 S2 r") * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 2) * (state == 2) * last_is("a2 S2 r") * ep_trial ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 2) * (state == 2) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 2) * (state == 2) * (tv("state", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 2) * (state == 2) * last_is("a2 S2 r") * (tv("state", -2) == 1)
explanation: Activation is zero at D1 and GO. It fires at D2 when the agent chose a2 and saw S2 (the common transition); a1 or rare-transition D2 steps stay near zero. Within those a2->S2 steps its size grows with trial in the episode. It peaks (about 1.2) on the first repeat after S2 pays off following a loss: the previous trial was a2 S2 rewarded and the trial before that was unrewarded. It stays raised when S1 was reached two trials back, and it shrinks over runs of repeated rewards, so it looks like a signal that S2 has just been confirmed. The observer belief adds little once these are in (small negative weight on belief_lo, so a bit higher when S2 is believed good). The free fit adds belief_lo and interactions with the a2 S2 r pattern (dev 0.28 vs short 0.25). Both are near the observed-cue ceiling (all observed 0.28), and most of the variance in peak size is still unexplained. No model outputs or future variables are used: in_state and in_action at D2 are observed inputs.
